g.text: p(t) proportional to t^alpha; 3M parameters, seed 0; lower is better
alpha = 1 is the headline run (alpha_effective = 1.0 in its config.json). Only solver settings committed for all three alphas are shown. The rk4 settings listed
in sweep_alpha.sh have no committed result for alpha 0 or 4. The two panels of each row share one y-range.
